## User-Facing Changes

Describe what a player or reviewer will notice. Use `N/A` if there is no user-facing change.

## Developer Notes

Describe the implementation, tradeoffs, and any internal migration details.

## Testing

List the checks you ran. If a relevant check was not run, explain why.

## Screenshots Or Video

Include visual proof for UI, asset, animation, or gameplay changes when practical.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title uses a conventional commit-style format.
- [ ] The change is self-contained or explains why it cannot be split.
- [ ] User-facing copy uses Mogger Mon terminology.
- [ ] Locale or submodule updates are included or explicitly noted.
- [ ] Inherited assets, prompts, or source references are not newly exposed.
